tagline: 奥林巴斯便携相机，1998 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于1998年推出的便携相机。

specs.闪光灯: Approx. 0.5 ~ 5.5 sec. (at normal temperature with new battery). Flash working range: Wide-angle — 0.6 ~ 6.4 m (2 ~ 21 ft), Telephoto — 0.9 ~ 2.3 m (3 ~ 7.5 ft)
specs.尺寸: 120 (W) x 65.5 (H) x 46 (D) mm (4.7 x 2.6 x 1.8 in) (without protrusions such as grip etc.).
specs.英文简介: The µ[mju:] ZOOM 140 Is a fully automatic 35mm compact camera introduced by Olympus in 1998[https://web.archive.org/web/20071210162239/http://www.olympus-global.com/en/corc/history/camera/popup/m_mjuzoom140.cfm?message=1 mju ZOOM 140 (Stylus) page at Olympus History Chronicle] (archived).
